title: Sheer Tulle Ruffle-Collar Maternity Photoshoot Gown
seo_title: Sheer Tulle Ruffle-Collar Maternity Gown | Dress Like Mommy
seo_desc: Sheer maternity photoshoot gown with a ruffled V collar, bell sleeves, satin sash and a large train. 4 colors, US 2 to 26W, made to order.
lead: Made for your maternity photos: a weightless sheer tulle gown with a ruffled V collar, romantic bell sleeves, a satin sash that ties above the bump and a long ruffle-edged train that floats behind you.
bullets: each gown is sewn after you order and is ready to ship in about 5 days, so please allow about 17-21 days for delivery. Order early for a planned photoshoot.
deep V-neck with ruffled tulle collar, three-quarter bell sleeves with ruffled cuffs, satin ribbon sash, open front and a large ruffle-edged train.
sheer tulle mesh. The gown is fully sheer, so plan to wear your own slip or lingerie underneath.
US 2 to US 16 and plus sizes US 18W to US 26W. Compare your bust, waist and hips with the chart below.
White, Gray, Bright Blue and Fuchsia Pink.
Hand wash cold or dry clean; hang to dry. Steam on low to remove creases.
chart_footnote: Body measurements in cm. Choose by your bust today; the open front and ribbon sash leave room for the bump. Hollow to Floor is measured from the base of the neck to the floor, barefoot.
closing: Perfect for maternity photoshoots, gender reveals and baby showers.
garment_lock: a fully sheer tulle maternity gown in robe style with a deep V-neck framed by a ruffled tulle collar, three-quarter bell sleeves with ruffled cuffs, a satin ribbon sash tied in a bow at the waist, an open front, and a very long skirt ending in a large round train edged with a tulle ruffle

image_prompt:
DRESS LIKE MOMMY — RELIABLE PHOTOSHOOT SYSTEM (automated run)

The attached images are the exact reference for ONE Shopify listing: a maternity photoshoot gown, "Sheer Tulle Ruffle-Collar Maternity Photoshoot Gown", in WHITE (a soft bright white).
The gown (ref1 full length, ref2 and ref3 the same gown): a fully sheer tulle maternity gown in robe style with a deep V-neck framed by a ruffled tulle collar, three-quarter bell sleeves with ruffled cuffs, a satin ribbon sash tied in a bow at the waist, an open front, and a very long skirt ending in a large round train edged with a tulle ruffle. The tulle, the collar ruffles and the sash are all white; the fabric is airy and see-through. Tasteful styling: she wears a plain nude-tone slip dress underneath so nothing is revealed; fully covered and elegant.

Generate FOUR separate images in this order and save each into the current working directory with exactly these names:
- image1.png — IMAGE 1, MAIN HERO: a visibly pregnant woman (about 7 months) standing in a bright, softly lit photo studio with a plain light grey backdrop, wearing this gown open at the front with the satin sash tied under the bust, one hand on her bump, the other lifting the sheer skirt; full length, front-facing, gown in sharp focus.
- image3.png — IMAGE 3, BEST OCCASION: the same woman at an outdoor maternity photoshoot in a sunlit meadow at golden hour, the sheer tulle and long train moving in the breeze; full length.
- image5.png — IMAGE 5, PRODUCT-ONLY: no people. The gown displayed on a dress form (mannequin) in a bright studio, the long sheer skirt and ruffle-edged train spread in a wide circle around the base, showing the ruffled V collar, bell sleeves and satin sash clearly.
- image6.png — IMAGE 6, ALTERNATE LIFESTYLE: the same pregnant woman on a beach at sunset with her partner (a man in a plain white shirt and beige trousers) standing behind her with his hands on her bump; she wears the gown; three-quarter length.
Do not ask me anything; continue until all four files are saved. Keep the same woman across images 1, 3 and 6.

Each output: one single vertical 9:16 photo, no collage, no borders, no text, no watermark. Crop minimally to 9:16 if needed.
PRODUCT LOCK: white colour, fully sheer robe-style tulle gown, ruffled V collar, three-quarter bell sleeves with ruffled cuffs, satin ribbon sash tied at the waist, open front and a large ruffle-edged train. No logos, no letters, no extra embellishment, no sequins.
MODEL STYLE: a natural-looking European woman, fair to light-medium skin, warm smile, tasteful and elegant; a different woman from the reference photos.
STRICT QUALITY CHECK before saving: reject and regenerate if the gown design or colour changed, the ruffled collar or bell sleeves are missing, she does not look pregnant, extra text appears, it is a collage, not 9:16, or it looks fake.
When all four files are saved, reply with one line per file: name, width x height.
